limitations_and_boundaries: The proposed metrics and DGN are evaluated only on transductive node classification tasks with limited datasets.
The study focuses on over-smoothing and does not address over-fitting or other deep GNN challenges.
DGN's performance depends on hyperparameter tuning (lambda and G), and extreme lambda values can damage performance.
The differentiable clustering uses a simple linear model; more advanced clustering methods are not explored.
The experiments are limited to GCN, GAT, SGC, and GCNII* backbones; applicability to other GNN architectures is not fully tested.
